definitions.explanation: The process of preserving food or other items by freezing them, or the state of being frozen.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}を{冷凍|れいとう}した。
{冷凍|れいとう}{食品|しょくひん}はとても{便利|べんり}だ。
{残|のこ}ったご{飯|はん}は{冷凍|れいとう}しておけば{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}ほど{持|も}つ。
examples.english: If you freeze leftover rice, it keeps for about a month.

notes:
Compound of {冷|れい} (cold) + {凍|とう} (freeze). One of the most common everyday words related to food storage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{冷凍|れいとう}する (to freeze)
・{冷凍|れいとう}{食品|しょくひん} (frozen food)
・{冷凍|れいとう}{庫|こ} (freezer)
・{冷凍|れいとう}{保存|ほぞん} (frozen storage)
・{冷凍|れいとう}{餃子|ギョーザ} (frozen gyoza)
・{冷凍|れいとう}ピザ (frozen pizza)
・{急速|きゅうそく}{冷凍|れいとう} (flash freezing)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{冷凍|れいとう}: freezing (below 0°C), for long-term preservation
・{冷蔵|れいぞう}: refrigeration (above 0°C), for short-term storage
